name: adverse_selection_filter_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY at 5-second resolution, institutional TWAP programs and FII basket orders create measurable directional volume imbalance within each bar, estimated via bulk volume classification (BVC): buy_vol = bar_vol × (close - low) / (high - low). When this imbalance is high over the past 5 minutes (VPIN above the 70th percentile of the recent 20-minute distribution), informed directional flow dominates and NIFTY price continuation over the next 30-90 seconds is likely — we buy the direction via momentum. When VPIN is low (below the 35th percentile), noise traders dominate, liquidity providers absorb the imbalance, and 2-minute RSI extremes revert within 30-60 seconds — we fade the move via mean-reversion. The dual-regime structure avoids the classic adverse-selection error of mean-reverting into an institutional order.

indicators.name: vpin_60
indicators.formula: abs(sum(buy_vol[i-60:i]) - sum(sell_vol[i-60:i])) / sum(volume[i-60:i]), where buy_vol = volume * (close - low) / (high - low) via BVC
indicators.purpose: 5-minute rolling VPIN (60 × 5s bars). This window is long enough to smooth single-bar noise while short enough to detect intraday regime transitions within a session. NIFTY institutional order runs typically last 3-10 minutes, so 5 minutes captures the active phase of a flow regime.

indicators.name: vpin_toxic_threshold
indicators.purpose: 20-minute rolling 70th-percentile of VPIN as the toxic-regime threshold. 240 bars (20 min) provides a live intraday baseline without requiring prior-day data or look-ahead. Adapts to session volatility regime so the same percentile correctly identifies 'high' in both a calm and a volatile session.

indicators.name: vpin_benign_threshold
indicators.purpose: Same 20-min window, 35th percentile as the benign-regime threshold. Leaves a neutral band (35th–70th percentile) where no trades are triggered, avoiding the regime boundary zone where misclassification is most likely.

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute RSI (24 × 5s) for mean-reversion signal in benign mode. The original used 14-minute RSI to catch multi-minute reversals on individual stocks. On NIFTY index, RSI extremes form and resolve faster because index smoothing damps stock-specific noise. 2-minute RSI captures the relevant short-term exhaustion at our 30-90s hold time, not a 14-minute swing.

indicators.name: mom_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute return (12 × 5s) for momentum signal in toxic mode. When VPIN is high, informed institutional flow typically sustains a direction for at least 30-60 seconds before filling. The 1-minute lookback identifies the established direction of the current institutional order without reaching back so far that the signal stales.

conditions: is_toxic AND mom_12 > momentum_threshold AND volume > 0.8 × vol_sma_36 (momentum continuation in informed-flow regime)
OR is_benign AND rsi_24 < rsi_oversold AND volume > 0.8 × vol_sma_36 (RSI-oversold bounce in noise regime)
buy_ce.confirmation: No simultaneous buy_pe; in_session filter active

conditions: is_toxic AND mom_12 < -momentum_threshold AND volume > 0.8 × vol_sma_36 (momentum continuation short side in informed-flow regime)
OR is_benign AND rsi_24 > rsi_overbought AND volume > 0.8 × vol_sma_36 (RSI-overbought fade in noise regime)
buy_pe.confirmation: No simultaneous buy_ce; in_session filter active

exit.stop_rationale: Benign-mode mean-reversion stop is 4 pts: a 2-minute RSI extreme on NIFTY reverts 8-15 spot pts; 4 option pts (delta ~0.5) allows the trade room for the initial flush before the bounce. Toxic-mode stop is 3 pts: institutional momentum that pauses within 30s has typically lost its order-flow driver; 3 pts is tight enough to exit before a full reversal.
exit.target_rationale: Benign-mode target 6 pts: median noise-regime RSI reversion covers ~12 spot pts → 6 option pts (1:1.5 R:R). Toxic-mode target 7 pts: informed-flow continuation covers 14-20 spot pts → 7-10 option pts; 7 pts captures the near-certain first leg without chasing (1:2.3 R:R for toxic mode).

filters.vix_filter: none — VIX regime indirectly encoded through VPIN percentile recalibration
filters.time_filter: 09:20–15:25 IST; first 5 minutes skipped to allow VPIN warmup
filters.volume_filter: volume > 0.8 × 3-minute rolling average; protects against ultra-thin 5s bars
filters.trend_filter: none — regime detection via VPIN replaces explicit trend filter

edge.edge_decay_risk: Moderate — VPIN approximation degrades when NIFTY volume becomes very thin (pre-expiry, circuit breaker). The BVC approximation is noisier than tick-level VPIN but captures the dominant directional signal in liquid sessions.

adaptation_notes: The original applied VPIN per individual NIFTY-50 stock requiring volume-bucketed tick data unavailable in our 5s pipeline. The index conversion approximates buy/sell volume via BVC (position of close in bar range) on 5s NIFTY futures-equivalent bars. The lookback compressed from the original's 50-bucket rolling window (~2-4 hrs on liquid stocks) to 5 minutes of 5s bars — appropriate because NIFTY index regimes turn over intraday, not multi-hour. RSI lookback reduced from 14 to 24 bars (2 min instead of 14 min) because we need the fast signal for 30-90s holds, not the slow recovery signal. Momentum lookback added at 12 bars (1 min) to match the toxic-flow trade's expected 30-60s continuation horizon.
weaknesses: BVC approximation of buy/sell volume is significantly noisier than tick-level VPIN — the signal quality ceiling is lower than the original.
NIFTY spot bars have irregular volume in the first and last 15 minutes, which can cause VPIN spikes unrelated to informed flow.
The neutral zone (35th–70th VPIN percentile) may result in no trades for extended flat sessions where VPIN stays range-bound.
Dual-regime logic (momentum in toxic, reversion in benign) doubles the parameter space and makes overfitting risk higher on limited 12-day backtest.
